findings.quote: Processing starts with complete requirements and payment.
findings.problem: This makes payment a universal starting condition. The processing-time rule requires payment only when a fee applies. A complete fee-free request does not need a payment before its processing clock can start.

findings.quote: Processing starts with complete requirements and payment.
findings.problem: The processing-start condition omits that payment applies only when applicable. Students need that limit to avoid treating fee-free requests as outside the stated processing deadlines.

accuracy_concerns.quote: Processing starts with complete requirements and payment.
accuracy_concerns.concern: Payment is stated without the applicable-fee condition. Fee-free transactions also have processing deadlines once their requirements are complete.
